items.title: Charlie Hardy Interview, 1961-12-16
items.q: It may have been. I didn't know him.

ctx.x: There was a Beisdorfer who, uh, played, uh, trumpets. Was he related?
It may have been. I didn't know him. But I knew Leonard Beisdorfer was a pianist, and he was a good one.
Are these, uh, white or colored boys?
